scope: Additive BUF-MIN official-gamebook correction. Preserves the prior exact-final source-gate blob and its truthful gamebook-unavailable observation, then records the stable official 16-page gamebook, complete starters/substitutes/DNP/not-active inventory, literal injury/status/return annotations, actual quarterback and specialist duties, and the still-missing official individual phase snap counts, distinct replacement allocations and immutable value bindings. No completed baseline, started-game prediction, fair, carried rating, market field or numerical injury loss is rewritten.

sources.finding: All 16 pages inspected. Page 1 binds the exact final, starters, substitutions, blank DNP rows and Not Active lists; pages 2-5 bind individual/team, specialist and defensive participation; pages 8-15 contain the complete play-by-play and printed injury/status/return notices. The gamebook has no individual offense/defense/special-teams snap-count table.
Binds final Buffalo injury designations, including Dawkins, Anderson and Gaines as Questionable and Palmer as Out; separates injury-linked candidates from non-injury inactive identities.
Binds Joshua Palmer to Reserve/Injured and Geno Stone/Trent Sherfield elevations; gamebook page 1 confirms Stone and Sherfield participated as substitutes.
Matches the six Minnesota Not Active identities and confirms Carson Wentz started with Max Brosmer as backup.
Binds Odell Beckham Jr. to the active roster, Demond Claiborne to Reserve/Injured and Tavierre Thomas to a game-day elevation; gamebook page 1 confirms Beckham and Thomas participated as substitutes.
Preserves the verified final, immutable kickoff/H4 and initial final inactive/transaction inventory without rewriting the earlier gamebook-unavailable observation.
